items.subject: mRNA-1273.222 (Bivalent Booster) regulatory approval process
items.statement: Execute the following steps in order: Submit Type B meeting request to FDA by 16 October 2026; Prepare Briefing Document with clinical and nonclinical data package; Engage external regulatory consultants for FDA interaction strategy; Brief Senior Leadership on regulatory pathway recommendation.
